patches.title: Initial Look Action
patches.principle: Always start a new task by using the look action to observe the entire room.
patches.when_to_apply: Immediately after the task description is given.

patches.title: Stay at Light Source
patches.principle: After switching on a lamp, examine the surface directly under it before moving to other areas.
patches.when_to_apply: After turning on a light source in a look_at_obj_in_light task.

patches.title: Limit Container Openings
patches.principle: Search open surfaces thoroughly before opening any containers; if not found, open containers one by one without backtracking.
patches.when_to_apply: When the target object is not immediately visible.
